articles.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.

articles.title: Poland upholds crypto bill veto as Zondacrypto scandal widens
articles.snippet: Polish lawmakers failed to overturn a presidential veto of crypto legislation as the Zondacrypto investigation expands and its Estonian operator enters bankruptcy.

articles.title: Trezor says data breach affects another 67K US customers
articles.snippet: Trezor said an additional 67,000 US users were affected by its shipping provider’s data breach, opening the path to potential phishing attacks and social engineering scams.

articles.title: BitMEX co-founder contributed 75% of Reform UK’s donations in Q2 2026
articles.snippet: The UK political party and its leader, Nigel Farage, have accepted contributions from figures tied to the crypto industry, raising questions about potential influence on policies.
